```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
```

```{r}
extract_parent_ID <- function(df_raw, generation) {
  # Extract ID of the parent except if gen 1, instead create a fake ID
  # param  : df_raw A tibble
  # param  : generation A num
  # return : df A tibble

  if (generation == 1) {
    n_id <- length(unique(df_raw$PROLIFIC_PID))
    df <- data.frame(
      "ID" = unique(df_raw$PROLIFIC_PID),
      "parent_ID" = paste("fake", 1:n_id)
    )
  } else {
    df <- df_raw %>%
      select(parent_PID, PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
      filter(parent_PID != "") %>%
      rename(
        "ID" = "PROLIFIC_PID",
        "parent_ID" = "parent_PID"
      )
  }

  df
}
```


```{r}
extract_and_correct_score <- function(df_raw) {
  # Extract score of each participant and apply the Kool's correction
  # param  : df_raw A tibble
  # return : df_score A tibble

  df_score <- df_raw %>%
    group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
    filter(trials.ran == 1) %>%
    select(
      PROLIFIC_PID,
      globa_score,
      t_mult,
      t_points,
      t_step1_stimLeft_reward,
      t_step1_stimRight_reward
    ) %>%
    rename(
      "ID" = "PROLIFIC_PID",
      "score" = "globa_score",
      "rew_choice" = "t_points",
      "rew_1" = "t_step1_stimLeft_reward",
      "rew_2" = "t_step1_stimRight_reward"
    ) %>%
    mutate(n_trial = 1:n()) %>%
    mutate(rew_1 = rew_1 * t_mult) %>%
    mutate(rew_2 = rew_2 * t_mult) %>%
    mutate(avg_rew = rowMeans(cbind(rew_1, rew_2))) %>%
    summarise(
      reward_rate = mean(rew_choice),
      avg_rew = mean(avg_rew),
      score_corrected = reward_rate - avg_rew
    ) %>%
    mutate(rank = rank(desc(score_corrected), ties.method = "first")) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, score_corrected, rank)

  df_score
}
```


```{r}
base_dir <- "../raw_data"


directory_df <- data.frame(
  directory_name = c(
    "2024-10-01_first_gen_obs",
    "2024-10-18_second_gen_obs",
    "2024-10-19_third_gen_obs",
    "2024-10-21_fourth_gen_obs",
    "2024-11-05_fifth_gen_obs",
    "2024-11-07_sixth_gen_obs"
  ),
  generation = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
)

df <- tibble()

for (i in directory_df$generation) {
  subfolder <- directory_df$directory_name[i]
  generation <- directory_df$generation[i]
  
  
  files_archived_subfolder <- list.files(
    path = file.path(base_dir, "archived", "run", subfolder, "not_selected"),
    pattern = ".csv",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  files_run_subfolder <- list.files(
    path = file.path(base_dir, "run", subfolder),
    pattern = ".csv",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  files <- c(files_archived_subfolder, files_run_subfolder)
  df_list <- vector("list", length(files))
  
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    df_temp <- read.csv(file = files[i], header = TRUE) %>%
      select(-SESSION_ID) %>% # cause error
      mutate(participant = as.character(participant))
    df_list[[i]] <- df_temp
  }
  
  df_raw <- bind_rows(df_list)
  df_raw <- as_tibble(df_raw)

  df_id <- extract_parent_ID(df_raw, generation)
  df_performance <- extract_and_correct_score(df_raw)
  df_gen <- right_join(df_performance, df_id, by = "ID")
  df_gen <- df_gen %>% mutate(gen = generation)
  
  df <- bind_rows(df, df_gen)
}

library(scales)

mean_bonus <- 2

df_bonus <- df %>%
  group_by(gen) %>%
  mutate(performance_bonus = rescale(score_corrected, to = c(0, mean_bonus))) %>%
  mutate(children_bonus = 0)

for (i in 1:nrow(df_bonus)) {
  parent <- df_bonus[i, ]
  if (sum(df_bonus$parent_ID == parent$ID) != 0) {
    df_children <- df_bonus %>%
      filter(parent_ID == parent$ID)
    children_bonus <- round(mean(df_children$performance_bonus, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    df_bonus[i, ]$children_bonus <- children_bonus
  }
}

df_bonus <- df_bonus %>%
  mutate(bonus = round(children_bonus + performance_bonus), 2)

```


```{r}
for (i in 1:nrow(directory_df)) {
  name <- directory_df$directory_name[i]
  generation <- directory_df$generation[i]
  write.table(
    df_bonus %>%
      filter(gen == generation) %>% 
      select(ID, bonus),
    file = file.path("../output/payment/", paste("data_bonus_", name, ".txt", sep = "")),
    sep = ",",
    row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
  )
}
```

# TEMP

```{r}
df_fitness <- df %>%
  select(
    ID,
    gen,
    score_corrected,
    pl1_understanding,
    pl2_understanding,
    rank
  )

i <- 1

for (id in df$ID) {
  df_children <- df %>% filter(parent_ID == id)
  n_C <- nrow(df_children)
  n_GC <- 0
  for (child_id in df_children$ID) {
    df_grandchildren <- df %>% filter(parent_ID == child_id)
    n <- nrow(df_grandchildren)
    n_GC <- n_GC + n
  }
  df_fitness[i, "n_C"] <- n_C
  df_fitness[i, "n_GC"] <- n_GC
  i <- i + 1
}
```


```{r}
cor.test(df_fitness$n_C, df_fitness$n_GC)
plot(df_fitness$n_C, df_fitness$n_GC)

cor.test(df_fitness$score_corrected, df_fitness$n_GC)
plot(df_fitness$score_corrected, df_fitness$n_GC)

cor.test(df_fitness$pl1_understanding, df_fitness$n_GC)
plot(df_fitness$pl1_understanding, df_fitness$n_GC)

cor.test(df_fitness$pl2_understanding, df_fitness$n_GC)
plot(df_fitness$pl2_understanding, df_fitness$n_GC)
```


PARTICIPANT ABOVE IQR / SD
```{r}
for (i in 1:10) {
  temp <- df %>% filter(gen == i) %>% pull(pl2_understanding)
  
  # plot(temp)
  
  Q1 <- quantile(temp, 0.25)
  Q3 <- quantile(temp, 0.75)
  
  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR(temp)
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR(temp)
  
  df_temp <- df %>%
    filter(gen == i) %>%
    mutate(outliers = ifelse(pl2_understanding > upper_bound, 1, 0))
  
  cat(i, "")
  cat(sum(df_temp$outliers), "\n")
}

for (i in 1:10) {
  df_temp <- df %>%
    filter(gen == i) %>%
    mutate(outliers = ifelse(pl2_understanding > 0.9, 1, 0))
  
  cat(i, "")
  cat(sum(df_temp$outliers), "\n")
}

```
